name: Data table
summary: The shared DataTable component — import it, pass data + columns, and every grid gets the DS V3 look and behaviour.
highlights: Shared DataTable: pass data and columns
Every grid gets the DS V3 look and behaviour
lead: The real component behind the Table pattern: one React component over antd v6 that owns the DS V3 table look (via dataTableTheme) AND its behaviour — single-arrow sort, checklist, min/max and typed-value filter popovers, drag reorder, right-click freeze, column resize, rows-per-page and edit columns. It has zero runtime dependencies: createDataTable({ React, antd }) binds it to your app's own React + antd, so it shares your theme context and works the same from a bundler or a CDN page. Call sites pass data + columns only — never a raw <Table>, never per-table styling.

spec.label: Container
spec.value: white surface, 1px #E3E3E3 border, radius 8 — wraps the grid

spec.label: Header
spec.value: white #fff + tertiary-grey #616161 labels; stays white on the sorted column

spec.label: Body
spec.value: horizontal dividers #E3E3E3 only, no zebra, no sorted-column tint

spec.label: Cell padding
spec.value: 16 (literal) on all four sides — never collapsed to 0

spec.label: Row hover
spec.value: gray-30 #F1F1F1

spec.label: Sort
spec.value: single arrow (system-arrow-up / system-arrow-down); an unsorted column shows a grey arrow pointing the way the first click sorts (↑ by default): cycle ↑ ascending → ↓ descending → none (a column's own sortDirections overrides the order, and the idle arrow follows its first entry)

spec.label: Filter
spec.value: funnel trigger: a real <button> in the header, reached with Tab, named "Filter: <column>" (labels.filterColumn), opens on Enter / Space a role="dialog" panel with the same name, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger; grey → pale pink hover → pale pink open → filled brand when applied; checklist (search + list; multi-select checkboxes, or single-choice DS radios with filter.multiple:false), min/max range, or one typed value (text, number or date field under the column label; Enter applies; a date field has a Clear button that empties it and puts focus back in the field), Reset + Apply footer

spec.label: Panel placement
spec.value: filter panels and the Edit columns panel open at the trigger's bottom-right corner and shift along the viewport edge when they do not fit, so they stay on screen with no page overflow from a 320px viewport up (antd's corner placements only flip). A column can replace this through filterDropdownProps.autoAdjustOverflow

spec.label: Single-choice filter
spec.value: filter: { type: 'checklist', options, multiple: false } — DS radios in the same search + list + Reset / Apply panel: picking an option replaces the last, Reset clears it, the column gets antd filterMultiple:false; multiple defaults to true (checkboxes, unchanged). Needs antd.Radio in createDataTable's antd (only for a column that sets it). Server-side: drive filteredValue + onChange(pagination, filters); filters[key] is a one-item array (['live']) or null, so read filters.status?.[0]

spec.label: Value filter
spec.value: filter: { type: 'value', inputType: 'text' | 'number' | 'date', label? } — text matches a case-insensitive substring, number an equal value, date the same calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD from the field; Date, timestamp or ISO cells compare in local time); a column's own onFilter replaces it (server-side filtering: drive filteredValue + onChange)

spec.label: Reorder
spec.value: drag a header (grab handle on hover) → Vivid Pink drop-line; Alt+←/→ on a focused header

spec.label: Freeze
spec.value: right-click (or the context-menu key on a focused header) → Freeze; one column at a time, jumps leftmost, pins with a shadow on scroll, no longer reorderable; Defreeze keeps it first

spec.label: Resize
spec.value: drag a header's right edge (min 80) or focus the separator and use ←/→

spec.label: Expandable rows
spec.value: one visual language for detail panel, tree rows, DataTable and plain Table: the chevron sits inline in the first column (24px + 8 gap, spacer on rows that cannot expand, so text always aligns); open parent row: keeps the plain surface, 600 weight and a primary chevron (no purple fill, no accent bar); its panel / child rows carry the gray-20 #F7F7F7 surface, which is what groups the expanded content (text on it 14:1+); detail panel = 16 padding (48 on the left, so panel content starts on the parent's text column), its blocks stacked 16 apart; every antd Table inside it is a white card (1px border-strong, radius 8) at one compact density (8 / 16 cells) whatever size it is given; a table with no expandable row gets no chevron column at all; tree children indent 24

spec.label: Expand chevron
spec.value: 24px button, system-caret-right rotating 0→90° on --aha-motion-mid + --aha-ease-in-out; hover bg-accent; visible focus ring; aria-expanded + aria-controls (the panel id, or the child row ids for a tree); Enter / Space; row click toggles too without double-toggling the chevron or firing from links / buttons / inputs

spec.label: Expand all / collapse all
spec.value: optional header toggle (expandAllToggle) in the first column header, above the row chevrons (aligned spacer when absent); aria-expanded reflects whether every expandable row is open

spec.label: Expanded state
spec.value: keyed by row key — survives sort, filter and pagination; several rows open at once; controlled (expandedRowKeys) or uncontrolled (defaultExpandedRowKeys)

spec.label: Detail sections
spec.value: DataTable.DetailSection (or DetailSection from createExpandableRows) = one titled block of a panel: 14px SemiBold title, 8 above its content; return one or several from renderDetail — e.g. a Questions sub-table above a Pages sub-table — and give the sub-tables no margin, padding or size of their own

spec.label: Cell alignment
spec.value: the chevron cell never inflates the row: the 24px chevron sits in a 22px line, so its text shares a baseline with every other cell (header and body) and decorated rows are as tall as plain ones; an ellipsis first column still ellipsises after the chevron

spec.label: Loading slot
spec.value: loadingKeys shows an <aha-spin> + status text in the panel (aria-busy) while a lazily fetched detail loads; fetch from onExpand

spec.label: Toolbar
spec.value: optional 18px SemiBold title left (a real heading, <h2> by default; toolbarTitleLevel picks 1–6) + optional search slot (toolbarSearch, 220–320 wide) + actions right (Edit columns, Export…); wraps on a phone

spec.label: Edit columns
spec.value: sliders button opens a checklist of the columns in display order; columnsSearchable adds a Search columns field above the list (cleared when the popover closes; "No columns match", labels.noColumnsMatch, when nothing matches); hideable:false rows are locked on; a Reset columns footer (restores defaultVisibleColumns, or every column) shows only when the app passes visibleColumns, defaultVisibleColumns or onColumnsReset

spec.label: Column visibility
spec.value: uncontrolled by default (defaultVisibleColumns seeds it, else every column shows); pass visibleColumns to control it — the table then shows exactly those keys (plus hideable:false columns) and onVisibleColumnsChange(visibleKeys) reports each toggle and Reset, visible keys in display order

spec.label: Highlighted row
spec.value: highlightedRowKey marks one row as the current one: Vivid Pink 5% (bg-accent) background, kept on hover, aria-current="true"; rows ticked through rowSelection keep antd's selected tint

spec.label: Test hooks
spec.value: stable data-testid on the toolbar (<prefix>-toolbar, -title, -search, -actions), each filter (<prefix>-filter-<key> on the trigger, -panel, -panel-search, -panel-input, -panel-min, -panel-max, -panel-clear, -panel-reset, -panel-apply) and Edit columns (<prefix>-columns-button, -panel, -search, -column-<key>, -empty, -reset); prefix = testIdPrefix, default aha-data-table

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: no rows → <aha-empty> with the empty-table illustration at 64 px and the noData caption ("No data"); locale.emptyText replaces it

spec.label: Pagination
spec.value: brand-outlined active page + "N / page" size changer (10 per page by default)

spec.label: Icons
spec.value: DS <aha-icon> by name — arrow, funnel, magnifying glass, drag, push-pin, question, sliders

props.name: columns
props.desc: antd columns + key (required for reorder/freeze), help (header (?) tooltip), filter { type:'checklist', options, multiple? } | { type:'range' } | { type:'value', inputType:'text'|'number'|'date', label? }, hideable:false (locks it in Edit columns and keeps it shown)

props.name: dataSource
props.desc: row data

props.name: rowKey
props.desc: unique row id

props.name: toolbarTitle
props.desc: toolbar title (left), rendered as a heading; omit title, search and actions to drop the toolbar

props.name: toolbarTitleLevel
props.desc: heading level of the toolbar title; the look stays 18px SemiBold at every level

props.name: toolbarSearch
props.desc: search slot between the title and the actions, e.g. an antd <Input> with the magnifying-glass prefix; the app filters dataSource itself

props.name: toolbarActions
props.desc: toolbar actions (right) — house antd <Button>s, e.g. Export

props.name: reorderable
props.desc: drag headers (or Alt+←/→) to reorder

props.name: freezable
props.desc: right-click a header to freeze / defreeze one column

props.name: resizable
props.desc: drag a header's right edge to resize

props.name: columnsEditable
props.desc: adds an Edit columns checklist to the toolbar (add / remove columns)

props.name: columnsSearchable
props.desc: adds a Search columns field to Edit columns (matches column titles, case-insensitive)

props.name: visibleColumns
props.desc: controlled visible column keys; the table shows exactly these (hideable:false columns always). Pair with onVisibleColumnsChange, e.g. to save each creator's columns or feed an export

props.name: defaultVisibleColumns
props.desc: uncontrolled starting set of visible keys, and what Reset restores

props.name: onVisibleColumnsChange
props.desc: fires on every Edit columns toggle and on Reset with the next visible keys, in display order

props.name: onColumnsEditorOpenChange
props.desc: the Edit columns popover opened (true) or closed (false) — e.g. log TABLE_COLUMNS_OPENED

props.name: onColumnToggle
props.desc: one column was ticked or unticked in Edit columns, before onVisibleColumnsChange

props.name: onColumnsReset
props.desc: Reset columns in Edit columns was pressed, before onVisibleColumnsChange; passing it shows the Reset columns footer

props.name: highlightedRowKey
props.desc: row key of the current row to highlight (bg-accent + aria-current); matched through rowKey

props.name: testIdPrefix
props.desc: prefix of every data-testid the table sets; give each table on a page its own

props.name: pagination
props.desc: merged over the default; set the starting size with defaultPageSize (pageSize is controlled and freezes the size changer); false hides it

props.name: expandableRows
props.type: { renderDetail?, rowExpandable?, expandAllToggle?, expandedRowKeys?, defaultExpandedRowKeys?, onExpandedRowsChange?, onExpand?, loadingKeys?, getRowLabel?, expandRowByClick?, childrenColumnName?, indentSize? }
props.desc: turns on expandable rows. With renderDetail(record) each row opens a detail panel — return free content or one or several DataTable.DetailSection blocks, each holding a sub-table (DataTable or plain Table, no margin / size needed); without it, rows carrying children open into tree rows. Do not pass antd's own expandable — it is replaced

props.name: labels
props.desc: UI copy override (i18n), every key defaults to the English text: searchInFilters, reset, apply, filterColumn, clearValue, minValue, maxValue, enterValue, freezeColumn, defreezeColumn, editColumns, searchColumns, resetColumns, noColumnsMatch, resizeColumn, noData and the expandable-row labels
every other antd Table prop passes through (loading, onChange, rowSelection, scroll…)

whenToUse.when: any rows×columns grid — results, leaderboard, participant / admin list
a row hides a detail panel / sub-table, or rows nest children (Report by-page, per-learner answers) — never a hand-rolled expandIcon caret
a bare antd Table restyled per call site is the drift this replaces — extend DataTable here instead
a non-columnar list or card stack — not a data grid

opinion.note: Create it once per app — export const DataTable = createDataTable({ React, antd }) — and import that everywhere. Call sites pass data + columns and choose the behaviours (reorderable / freezable / resizable / columnsEditable); they never pass styling. Missing a behaviour? Add it to lib/aha-data-table.js so every table gets it. A status pill inside a cell is Status badge, not custom colour.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: A CDN-React page: React + antd load from esm.sh and are handed to the SAME createDataTable React apps import. No build step.

snippets.label: Vue 3
snippets.note: The behaviour layer is React-first; Vue binds the same dataTableTheme for the DS V3 look until the Vue twin ships.

codeNote: createDataTable takes your React + antd instead of importing them, so the DS package stays dependency-free and the table always renders inside your app's own React tree and antd theme context. The expandable-rows behaviour lives in lib/table-expandable.js (createExpandableRows) and is shared with a plain tableTheme Table, so both render the same chevron, panel and a11y contract.

selfCheck.label: white header + grey labels (also when sorted)
checklist + range + value filters, Reset / Apply
reorder · freeze · resize · edit columns (controlled visibility + events)
expandable rows: chevron button, aria-expanded / aria-controls, row-key state
DS icons by name (no emoji / icon packs)
